verdict.rationale: Rev AI is a speech-to-text API service, so an official CLI is a fair thing to ask about, but the evidence shows none. The pack documents a REST/WebSocket API, SDKs, and an MCP server for Cursor. The 'running the command below' line in the getting-started guide refers to an API call example, not a first-party CLI tool. SDKs and the MCP server are different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
